method: Every support extrusion is a circumscribed width+0.002 mm footprint and full recorded height slab. For every slab, intersect its XY footprint with both (a) all model bead footprints whose recorded bottom is below its top, and (b) projections of every current STL surface clipped below that top. Empty intersections prove that the entire support prism union can translate continuously in -printZ until below the part, without assuming branch separation, flexibility, or a thin probe. Slab height simplification is conservative: each same-layer footprint uses the maximum top/minimum bottom of its actual records. Surface line/point projections retained.
limits: Nominal bead envelope only, not measured PETG.
Contact separation/adhesion force, grip, surface damage and debris are not proven.
Print-bed removal precedes support extraction; no adhesion model.
Clearance does not establish print strength or physical dimensional acceptance.
